risks.desc: The engine contract could be misread as ownership of individual domain models or authority to execute migrations.
risks.mitigation: Keep domain models outside this node, reject executable migration payloads and preserve runtimeProviderClaimAllowed=false plus NO-GO.

rollback: Row-to-node parity, exact dependency, WBS, schedule, version-validation or negative-boundary drift withdraws this descendant application; the 620-node state is regenerated without runtime or domain-model mutation.
